pois.name: Single Fin
pois.description: Uluwatu's landmark cliff-edge bar and restaurant — open-air thatched terraces 50m above Impossibles surf break. Sunday sunset DJ sets are a Bali institution. Book a terrace table for golden hour.

pois.name: Pura Luhur Uluwatu
pois.description: One of Bali's six kayangan jagat directional temples, perched on a 70m limestone cliff above the Indian Ocean. Founded in the 11th century. Daily Kecak fire-dance performance at 18:00 on the clifftop stage.

pois.name: Omnia Bali
pois.description: Cliff-edge infinity-pool day club with resident international DJs. Entry includes a drink credit. The pool hangs 100m over the Indian Ocean. Dress code enforced after 18:00.

pois.name: Bingin Beach
pois.description: Steep concrete-step access to a short left-hand reef break. Best at 3–6 ft SW swell, intermediate level minimum. Warungs and surf shops line the clifftop car park.

pois.name: Ayodhya Uluwatu
pois.description: Modern clifftop villa resort with direct access to the Impossibles surf break. Minimalist architecture, private pools, and unobstructed Indian Ocean views from every villa.

pois.name: Nyang Nyang Beach
pois.description: Uluwatu's most secluded white-sand beach — 400 steps down a cliff face, 800m of sand, no warungs. Weekday mornings are near-empty. Bring food and water.
